title: Global vs. Local Revisions — Editing Your Writing
skills: distinguish global revision from local revision
evaluate drafts for organization, development, purpose, and coherence
identify sentence-level issues involving grammar, wording, and mechanics
prioritize large-scale revisions before surface-level editing
alignment_note: Explains the difference between global revisions that address structure, ideas, development, and coherence and local revisions that address sentence-level clarity, grammar, wording, and mechanics. Supports effective revision planning, editing, and recursive writing practice across high school English courses.
